# T-2: Add bulk confirmation

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Require explicit confirmation before bulk update applies a prepared enabled-package update plan.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `y` and `yes` approve the update.
- Empty input, `n`, `no`, and any other input refuse the update.
- Refusal leaves package commits and installed plugin files unchanged.
- `--json` prompt/refusal/status text does not corrupt stdout JSON.

## Implementation Notes
Read stdin only for bulk update. Parse confirmation with a small helper. Candidate display must happen before the prompt and mutation must happen after acceptance. In JSON mode, write prompt and non-JSON status text to stderr.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local CLI tests feed stdin variants and inspect package commit state before and after execution.
